findings.item: H1 says what the page is about
findings.detail: the headline is split across 5 blocks, so no single one can carry it
findings.fix: The template animates this headline a word at a time, so it was measured as separate blocks. Write the whole headline into the first of them in Edit content and clear the rest.
A jump from H2 to H4 reads to a crawler as a missing section. Demote or promote so each level follows the one above.
It does not rank the page, it decides whether anyone clicks it. One sentence on what the business does, one on what to do next.

findings.item: Enough on the page to rank

findings.fix: “Read more” tells a crawler nothing about what it points at. Name the destination: “See our skin treatments”.

findings.item: Internal links to the rest of the site

findings.fix: Alt text is the only thing a crawler reads of a photo. Describe it plainly; do not list keywords.
Rename them before upload: “skin-clinic-johor-bahru-treatment-room.jpg”. It is most of image search.

findings.detail: no canonical link on the page
findings.fix: Set it in Yoast once the page has a real URL. It is what stops a duplicate at ?utm= splitting the page's own signals.
Without og:title, og:description and og:image, a link pasted into WhatsApp shows a bare URL. For a clinic that is most of how the page travels.
Add LocalBusiness schema with the name, address, phone and opening hours. It is what puts the map pack details and the rating stars in the result.

findings.item: Name, address and phone all on the page
findings.detail: missing from the page: name, address, phone
findings.fix: A model deciding whether two mentions are the same business matches on these three together. One missing and the page stops confirming the entity.
